claims.claim: Spoken / sighted Fastnet 140 miles W of Fastnet (18th inst.)
claims.verbatim:
Steamship City of Boston, Brooks, Liverpool 16th, via Queenstown
17th inst., with mdse. and pass. to John G. Dale. Anchored off Sandy
Hook 10:30 p. m., 26th. 16th inst. passed steamships City of London
and Erin, bound up the Channel; 18th inst., 140 miles W of Fastnet,
steamship Scotland, bound W; 26th, off Nantucket, steamship Bel-
lona, bound W.
